scenes.hook: Imagine several people listening to the same television through their own earbuds. Auracast is designed for shared audio.
scenes.idea: A compatible transmitter broadcasts an audio stream that nearby compatible receivers can join.
scenes.demo: Instead of creating a separate one to one link for every listener, one broadcast serves many receivers.
scenes.compare: A phone or another assistant can help you discover the broadcast and choose which stream to hear.
scenes.takeaway: An ordinary Bluetooth label alone is not enough. Check Auracast support on both ends of the connection.
scenes.close: Where would shared audio be useful? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
